label: Scene Template: Kinetic Manifesto
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: the kinetic-type statement beat. ONE sentence owns the frame with scale/weight contrast; accent words in brand color, camera punch throughout. Two entrances: default house line-rise (whole sentence lands as one block), or entrance:'type-on' (words appear in place in reading order and the centered flow re-centers as it grows -- the word-by-word build-up). Use for the film's thesis line, a pivotal claim, or a short emotional statement (4-14 words) -- the pure-typography breath between denser scenes. Dark by default.

text.label: The sentence (4-14 words). Wrap key words in *stars* to accent them

accent_words.label: Alternative to stars: words to accent in brand color

logo_url.label: Wordmark URL; defaults to the brand-kit wordmark

uniform.label: true = all words same size (skip the small-connective-word shrink)

entrance.label: rise (default, whole-sentence house entrance) | type-on (word-by-word build-up with live re-centering)

at.label: type-on only: when the first word lands (default 0.3)

word_interval.label: type-on only: seconds between words (default 0.14). Set to the beat subdivision to cut on music.

word_times.label: type-on only: explicit per-word times in seconds (overrides word_interval)

ramp_words.label: Words to render with the per-glyph gradient ramp (primary → magenta → orange) — the st-statement 'rainbow' emphasis.
